experiment_data.hypothesis: Extending r=0.2 from 5gen to 10gen will reveal whether the dip-then-recovery pattern (Type II) persists or transitions to sustained decline. If SLV continues rising through Gen 10 (like r=0.25), r=0.2 is firmly Type II. If SLV plateaus or declines after Gen 5, r=0.2 may be closer to the Type I/II boundary, providing finer resolution of the phase diagram near r_crit.
